sql.where:
DELETE_FLAG = 0
AND LEASE_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{leaseNo}, '%')
AND LESSOR_COMPANY LIKE CONCAT('%', #{lessorCompany}, '%')
AND LEASE_TYPE = #{leaseType}
AND LEASE_STATUS = #{leaseStatus}
AND LEASE_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND LEASE_END_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM TBL_FINANCIAL_LEASE
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_FINANCIAL_LEASE WHERE LEASE_ID = #{leaseId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0
mapper.insert:
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()
INSERT INTO TBL_FINANCIAL_LEASE ( LEASE_NO, LESSOR_COMPANY, CONTRACT_NO, LEASE_TYPE, ASSET_NAME, ASSET_VALUE, LEASE_START_DATE, LEASE_END_DATE, LEASE_TERM, LEASE_RATE, TOTAL_LEASE_AMOUNT, PAYMENT_METHOD, PAYMENT_CYCLE, GUARANTEE_TYPE, GUARANTEE_AMOUNT, CURRENCY, LEASE_STATUS, REMAINING_PRINCIPAL, TOTAL_PAID_AMOUNT, OPERATOR, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_BY, DELETE_FLAG ) VALUES ( #{leaseNo}, #{lessorCompany}, #{contractNo}, #{leaseType}, #{assetName}, #{assetValue}, #{leaseStartDate}, #{leaseEndDate}, #{leaseTerm}, #{leaseRate}, #{totalLeaseAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentCycle}, #{guaranteeType}, #{guaranteeAmount}, #{currency}, #{leaseStatus}, #{remainingPrincipal}, #{totalPaidAmount}, #{operator}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as TOTAL_LEASE_AMOUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN LEASE_STATUS = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as TOTAL_PAID_AMOUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN LEASE_STATUS = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as REMAINING_PRINCIPAL, SUM(CASE WHEN LEASE_STATUS = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as LEASE_TERM FROM TBL_FINANCIAL_LEASE WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0
